fields.text: Shipped offline sync for the field inspection app
Cut median report export time from 9 seconds to 2 by batching photo uploads
Retired the legacy permit lookup endpoint after two weeks of zero traffic
Moving the permit fee calculator to the shared rules library
Accessibility pass on the inspector dashboard
Pilot photo redaction with two county offices

fields.title: Report export times out for reports with 200+ photos
fields.description: Large reports hit the 60 second gateway timeout.

fields.title: Offline sync conflicts lose inspector edits
fields.description: Because two inspectors can edit the same report offline, the later sync might overwrite the earlier one, which would lose findings.
fields.mitigation: Field-level merge shipped in !218; monitor the conflict rate weekly.

note: Raised in the sync design review; risks come to you as cards
